name: Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited
summary: Dolphin Offshore Enterprises (India) Limited provides offshore and marine services to the oil and gas industry in India. The company offers diving and underwater services, including underwater construction services entailing modification and redevelopment of existing offshore facilities; pre-engineering surveys; diving support for pipe laying and pipeline stabilization; inspection, maintenance, and repair of platforms; installation and replacement of tie-ins, risers, and conductors; underwater ship repair and maintenance; rig support diving services, including UWILD surveys; and inspection required for various certifying bodies.
